_note: Your base resume, the only copy. Setup fills this from your existing resume; edit it any time. gen.js builds every tailored resume and cover letter from it. Leave a section empty ([] or "") to leave it off the resume.
name: Full Name
summary: Two or three sentences: who you are, your strongest relevant experience, and the kind of role you want.

experience.title: Job title, Employer, Location
experience.text: What you did and the result, with numbers where you have them.

strengths: One line showing it in action.
defaultAvailability: One sentence on work rights and when you can start, used in every cover letter.
coverLetterFacts: True facts the cover letters may use, e.g. citizenship, your proudest project, notice period.
